stepBody: Angela proposes to model some particular observation $$y_i$$ as follows: $$\hat{y}_i $$=$$ \frac{1}{\theta_1} $$x_i$$\n\n(a)(i) Take the derivative with respect to $$\theta_1$$ of the Mean Squared Error (MSE) of Angela's model. Please simplify your answer in terms of $$x_i$$, $$y_i$$, $$\theta_1$$ and $$n$$.
